preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices and must not connect a vertex to itself.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1 for a valid tree.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the number of paths chosen.

postconditions.expression: all(len(path) == len(edges_in_path) + 2 for path in paths_output)
postconditions.description: Each path description must have the correct number of elements.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 1 for x in x_values)
postconditions.description: All distances x must be between 0 and 1.
